Name: Boar Mount - The Sassy Talking Wild Boar
Author: sushitrash204
Description:
🐗 BOAR MOUNT - PIGGY
[i]A sassy, high-speed talking wild boar mount for Stardew Valley 1.6[/i]
[line]
[heading]Overview[/heading]
Tired of the same old horse? Pelican Town has a new four-legged resident with a big attitude!
Meet [b]Piggy[/b] — a fast, talking wild boar who won't hesitate to launch anyone into the sky if they stand too close.
[heading]Features[/heading]
[list]
[*][b]Intro Cutscene:[/b] Visit the Bus Stop to witness Mayor Lewis's chaotic first encounter with Piggy.[/*]
[*][b]Piggy's Flute:[/b] After the cutscene, buy the flute at Marnie's Ranch for [b]3,000g[/b] to summon Piggy anywhere, anytime.[/*]
[*][b]Speed & Sound:[/b] Moves faster than standard horses (+2 speed), with custom boar grunts and galloping sounds.[/*]
[*][b]Villager Ramming:[/b] Charge into villagers and send them flying! This feature can be toggled in the config.[/*]
[*][b]Interactive Dialogue:[/b] Hold [b]Shift + Right Click[/b] to talk with Piggy, complete with vanilla-style pixel portraits and sassy dialogue.[/*]
[*][b]Configurable:[/b] Full [b]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/b] support to adjust speed, hotkeys, and offsets in-game.[/*]
[/list][heading]How to Unlock[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Visit the [b]Bus Stop[/b] between [b]6:00 AM and 2:00 AM[/b] to trigger the intro cutscene.[/*]
[*]Check your mailbox the next morning for a letter from Marnie.[/*]
[*]Visit [b]Marnie's Ranch[/b] and purchase [b]Piggy's Flute[/b] for 3,000g.[/*]
[*]Use the flute to summon Piggy and ride off on your new companion![/*]
[/list][heading]Installation & Compatibility[/heading]
[list]
[*]Requires [b]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/b] and [b]SMAPI 4.0+[/b].[/*]
[*]Extract the
[code]BoarMount[/code]folder into your
[code]Mods[/code]directory.[/*]
[*]Safe to install on an existing save.[/*]
[*]Does not replace your standard horse.[/*]
[*]Supports [b]English and Vietnamese[/b], automatically following your game's language settings.[/*]
[/list]
